@media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:portrait){.rotate{position:fixed;z-index:999;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;background:#081422;padding:36px;font-size:20px;font-weight:850;color:#d8f8f0}}
.thiefAlert{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:35;background:#0714237f;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px;pointer-events:auto}.thiefAlert[hidden]{display:none!important}.thiefAlertPanel{width:min(520px,100%);border:2px solid #f0c46b;background:#112439f5;border-radius:13px;padding:17px 22px 16px;box-shadow:0 10px 35px #000b;text-align:center;color:#f8f7ef}.thiefAlertEyebrow{font:bold 11px monospace;letter-spacing:1px;color:#f1c86e}.thiefAlertPanel h2{font-size:20px;margin:8px 0}.thiefAlertPanel p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin:8px 0 14px;white-space:pre-line}.thiefAlertPanel button{min-width:200px}@media(max-width:600px){.thiefAlertPanel{padding:10px 12px}.thiefAlertPanel h2{font-size:16px}.thiefAlertPanel p{font-size:11px}}

/* v0.5.6as — player-facing in-viewport HUD; developer controls remain in aside */
.gameHUD{position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;z-index:18;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px;pointer-events:none;width:min(276px,calc(100% - 20px));font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.gameHUD button{pointer-events:auto}
.hudPause{height:35px;min-width:118px;border:1px solid #b7b3d0;border-bottom:3px solid #676b9a;border-radius:5px;background:#142b40ed;color:#fff;font:900 13px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0009}
.hudPause:hover{background:#2d4d66}
/* Player controls remain separate from the right-side POSM HUD. */
.gameControls{position:absolute;left:10px;top:9px;z-index:26;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;pointer-events:auto}
.hudFullscreen{display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;min-width:42px;padding:0;touch-action:manipulation}
.hudFullscreen svg{display:block;width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:square;stroke-linejoin:miter}
.hudFullscreen .exitIcon{display:none}
.hudFullscreen[aria-pressed="true"] .enterIcon{display:none}
.hudFullscreen[aria-pressed="true"] .exitIcon{display:block}
/* Fullscreen API mode and immersive CSS fallback for browsers without it. */
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback){position:relative;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh;max-width:none;margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#09121e}
.shell.fullscreen-fallback{position:fixed;z-index:1000}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .top,
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .bottom,
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .foot{display:none}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .layout{display:block;height:100%}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .gameCard{position:relative;height:100%;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .viewport{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;aspect-ratio:auto}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .statline{position:absolute;z-index:12;top:45px;left:0;right:252px;border:0;background:#091b2ab8;padding:4px 9px;pointer-events:none;font-size:10px;min-height:27px}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .aside{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;z-index:22;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:165px;height:100%;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:0;border-left:2px solid #50748a;background:#0a1729f2;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .22s ease}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback).tech-open .aside{transform:translateX(0)}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .debugToggle{display:block}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .gameHUD{right:8px;top:5px;width:min(242px,calc(100% - 170px))}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback).tech-open .gameHUD{right:172px}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .hudPanel{max-height:calc(100dvh - 18px)}
.shell:is(:fullscreen,:-webkit-full-screen,.fullscreen-fallback) .overlayState{right:0}

.hudPanel{pointer-events:auto;width:100%;padding:10px;background:#0b1b2cef;border:2px solid #47687b;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 9px 25px #010812b8;max-height:calc(100% - 41px);overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.hudSectionLabel{font:bold 9px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#87c7c8;letter-spacing:1px;margin:8px 0 5px;text-align:left}
.hudSectionLabel:first-child{margin-top:0}
.hudScores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.hudScores>div{padding:5px 1px 4px;background:#193246;border:1px solid #385970;border-radius:4px;text-align:center}
.hudScores b{display:block;color:#f8f2d8;font:bold 21px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hudScores small{display:block;color:#acc9cb;font:bold 9px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.hudWallet{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.hudWallet>div{background:#192e3f;border:1px solid #3e6373;border-radius:4px;padding:6px;text-align:center}
.hudWallet>div>span{display:block;color:#b8cdd2;font-size:9px}
.hudWallet b{color:#ffda8e;font:bold 15px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.hudProtected{margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;color:#d9cea6;text-align:center}
.hudKinds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
.hudKind{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:5px;min-height:46px;background:#1a3146;color:#e7eef4;border:1px solid #4b6c80;border-bottom:3px solid #263e54;border-radius:4px;padding:5px 4px;text-align:left;font:bold 10px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.hudKind strong{color:#f4c67e;font-size:19px;min-width:19px}
.hudKind span{flex:1;min-width:0;line-height:1.1}
.hudKind span small{display:block;color:#9fb4c2;font-size:8px;margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:.2px}
.hudKind em{align-self:flex-end;font:normal 8px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#e6c98d;font-style:normal}
.hudKind.active{border-color:#7af6c9;background:#185a56;color:white;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #3ca889}
.hudKind:disabled,.hudBuy button:disabled{opacity:.36;cursor:not-allowed}
.hudBuy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.hudBuy button{height:33px;border:1px solid #698a92;border-bottom:3px solid #315666;background:#205363;color:#d6f9ef;border-radius:4px;font:900 12px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;white-space:nowrap}
.hudBuy button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#267f79}
.hudBuy b{color:#fff0be}
.hudStart{width:100%;min-height:35px;background:#19725c;border:1px solid #8ce8bc;border-bottom:3px solid #0b493c;border-radius:4px;color:#fff;font:bold 12px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;margin-top:8px}
.hudStart:hover{background:#26906d}
.arcadePause{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:49;background:#05111ddd;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;pointer-events:auto}
.arcadePause[hidden],.pausePage[hidden],.hudStart[hidden]{display:none!important}
.arcadePauseCard{width:min(380px,100%);max-height:min(95%,550px);overflow-y:auto;border:3px solid #61b8aa;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#162c41,#081728);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #132e41,0 15px 50px #000e;border-radius:8px;text-align:center;padding:16px 21px 12px;font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.arcadePauseBrand{color:#77e7c8;font:bold 10px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.arcadePauseCard h2{font:bold 27px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1px;margin:8px 0 13px;color:#fff4d8;text-shadow:2px 3px 0 #0b131e}
.pauseSub{font:bold 11px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#a7becb;letter-spacing:1px;margin:8px 0 12px}
.pauseAction{width:100%;min-height:35px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:7px 10px;background:#19364b;border:1px solid #587b8c;border-bottom:3px solid #29465d;border-radius:4px;color:#eaf9ff;font:bold 12px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;text-align:center}
.pauseAction.primary{background:#14735e;border-color:#7fe6ca}.pauseAction.danger{background:#523042;border-color:#ae687b}.pauseAction:hover{filter:brightness(1.25)}
.pauseSetting{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:left;margin:7px 0;background:#192f42;border:1px solid #375669;border-radius:5px;padding:9px;font:12px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.pauseSetting input{accent-color:#6fdfb4;width:17px;height:17px}
.pauseHelp{color:#a3becc;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;text-align:left}
.pauseHint{margin-top:7px;color:#778b9d;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px}
.recordsContent{font-size:12px;color:#d8eced;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 10px;max-height:210px;overflow:auto}
.recordsContent table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.recordsContent td{border-bottom:1px solid #304c5d;padding:5px;text-align:right}
.recordsContent td:first-child{text-align:left;color:#b7dce0}
.debugToggle{display:none;position:absolute;left:10px;top:53px;z-index:22;border:1px solid #9ccecf;border-radius:4px;background:#17364ddf;color:#e0f0f6;padding:6px 9px;font:bold 11px monospace}
.editing .gameHUD{display:none}
.editing .arcadePause{display:none!important}
@media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:landscape){
.debugToggle{display:block}
.gameControls{left:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left));top:max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-top));gap:5px}
.hudFullscreen{width:35px;min-width:35px}
.hudFullscreen svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.statline{top:40px;right:252px}
.debugToggle{top:73px;left:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}

.shell.tech-open .aside{transform:translateX(0)}
.gameHUD{right:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-right));top:max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-top));width:min(242px,calc(100% - 165px));gap:4px}
.shell.tech-open .gameHUD{right:172px}
.hudPause{height:30px;min-width:86px;font-size:11px}
.hudFullscreen{min-width:35px}
.hudPanel{padding:6px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 40px)}
.hudScores b{font-size:16px}.hudScores small{font-size:8px}
.hudWallet{margin-top:5px}.hudWallet b{font-size:12px}
.hudKind{min-height:35px;font-size:9px;padding:3px}.hudKind strong{font-size:14px;min-width:14px}.hudKind span small{font-size:7px}
.hudSectionLabel{margin:4px 0 3px}
.hudBuy button{height:28px;font-size:10px}
.hudStart{min-height:28px;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}
.arcadePause{right:0}.arcadePauseCard{padding:9px 14px;max-height:95%}.arcadePauseCard h2{font-size:19px;margin:3px 0 6px}.arcadePauseBrand{font-size:8px}.pauseSub{font-size:9px;margin:4px 0}.pauseAction{min-height:27px;font-size:10px;padding:4px;margin-bottom:4px}.pauseHint{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:600px) and (orientation:landscape){.gameHUD{width:min(190px,calc(100% - 135px))}.hudProtected{display:none}}

/* v0.5.6au: real POSM-art retro HUD, without altering gameplay logic */
.gameHUD{width:min(402px,calc(100% - 20px));gap:0;font-family:monospace}
.hudPanel.pixelHud{background:#071a2bee;border:3px solid #13a8cb;border-radius:0;padding:9px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #092b43,0 0 0 2px #02111a,5px 7px 0 #0008;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;scrollbar-width:thin}
.pixelHud .hudScores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.pixelHud .hudScores>div{border:2px solid #0878a0;background:#081e32;border-radius:0;box-shadow:inset 2px 2px 0 #163d52,inset -2px -2px 0 #03121e;display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;align-items:center;padding:5px 8px;text-align:left;gap:0 5px}
.pixelHud .hudScores .hudScoreHero{grid-column:1/-1;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto;grid-template-rows:1fr;min-height:47px}
.pixelHud .pixelMetricName{color:#b6dce8;font:bold 11px monospace;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pixelHud .hudScores b{font:bold 22px monospace;color:#fcd55e;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #654420;display:block;grid-column:2;grid-row:2}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero b{font-size:30px;grid-column:3;grid-row:1;justify-self:end}
.pixelHud .hudScoreMinor:nth-child(2) b{color:#68e58c;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #215e3b}
.pixelHud .hudScoreMinor:nth-child(3) b{color:#ff7569;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #6f242a}
.pixelHud .pixelIcon{color:#f9b84e;font:bold 24px monospace;grid-column:1;grid-row:1 / 3;filter:drop-shadow(1px 2px 0 #042033)}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero .pixelIcon{font-size:29px;grid-row:1}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero .pixelMetricName{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}
.pixelHud .hudWallet{margin-top:6px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
.pixelHud .hudWallet>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:27px 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:0 3px;align-items:center;text-align:left;border:2px solid #0878a0;border-radius:0;background:#081e32;padding:6px}
.pixelHud .hudWallet>div>span:not(.pixelMoneyIcon){font:bold 10px monospace;color:#bad9e5;grid-column:2}

.pixelHud .hudWallet b span{font:inherit}
.pixelHud .hudProtected{margin-top:6px;background:#102b3a;border:1px solid #315b68;padding:4px;text-align:center;font:bold 10px monospace;color:#bbd9d9}
.pixelHud .hudSectionLabel{margin:9px 0 5px;color:#bde8f5;font:bold 12px monospace;letter-spacing:.5px;text-align:left}
.pixelHud .hudKinds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.pixelHud .hudKind{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;min-height:133px;min-width:0;padding:4px 3px;gap:2px;border-radius:0;border:2px solid #4c7e93;border-bottom:4px solid #1e465b;background:#17293a;color:#eef4f1;text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 2px 2px 0 #39566a;font:bold 10px monospace}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stand]{background:#382b1b;border-color:#bc8c38}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=theater]{background:#34242b;border-color:#a85d60}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stripe]{background:#342337;border-color:#966194}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=permanent]{background:#292d32;border-color:#6f777b}
.pixelHud .hudKind.active{outline:2px solid #b4fb72;outline-offset:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #325b20,inset 2px 2px 0 #3b6c53}
.pixelHud .hudKind:disabled{opacity:.5}
.pixelHud .hudImageWrap{height:82px;width:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 82px}
.pixelHud .hudEquipmentImage{max-width:100%;max-height:79px;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(2px 3px 0 #0009)}

.pixelHud .hudBuy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button{height:63px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1px;background:#09293e;border:2px solid #0878a0;border-bottom:4px solid #09506a;border-radius:0;padding:3px 1px;color:#d7f2ff;font:bold 10px monospace;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

.pixelHud .hudBuy button:nth-child(3) .hudBuyPlus{background:#bc3e82}

@media(max-height:450px) and (orientation:landscape){.pixelHud .hudKind{min-height:72px}.pixelHud .hudImageWrap{height:34px;flex-basis:34px}.pixelHud .hudEquipmentImage{max-height:33px}.pixelHud .hudBuy button{height:39px}.pixelHud .hudSectionLabel{margin:3px 0 2px}}

/* v0.5.6au — independent, offline, genuine pixel-outline UI font */
@font-face{font-family:'POSM Pixel';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:100 900;font-style:normal;font-display:block}
:root{--pixfont:'POSM Pixel',monospace;--pix-ink:#061724;--pix-cyan:#37d9ed;--pix-gold:#ffcf62;--pix-blue:#0a314e}
/* Preserve the current gameplay layout and the original POSM art. */
.gameHUD,.gameControls,.arcadePause,.statline,.debugToggle,.overlayState .poster{font-family:var(--pixfont)!important}
.pixelHud,.pixelHud button,.pixelHud b,.pixelHud small,.pixelHud em,.pixelHud span,.gameControls button,.arcadePause button,.arcadePauseCard,.arcadePauseCard *{font-family:var(--pixfont)!important;font-kerning:none;font-synthesis:none}
.pixelHud .pixelMetricName,.pixelHud .hudSectionLabel,.pixelHud .hudItemName,.pixelHud .hudItemName small,.pixelHud .hudBuy button,.hudPause,.pauseSub,.pauseAction{letter-spacing:.15px}
.hudPanel.pixelHud{border:4px solid #073b56;background:#061624f4;outline:2px solid #22c6e5;outline-offset:-1px;border-radius:0;padding:10px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #44d6e9,inset 0 0 0 5px #103b59,0 0 0 3px #02101c,5px 6px 0 #010812c9;scrollbar-color:#317c9b #081723}
.pixelHud .hudScores{gap:7px}
.pixelHud .hudScores>div,.pixelHud .hudWallet>div{border:3px solid #0b6e91;background:#081e31;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #164762,inset 0 0 0 4px #071727,2px 2px 0 #010d17;padding:6px 7px;border-radius:0;image-rendering:pixelated}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#102e43,#081b2c)!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores b,.pixelHud .hudWallet b{font-weight:900;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #1c2730;line-height:1.16;white-space:nowrap}
.pixelHud .hudScores b{font-size:23px}.pixelHud .hudScoreHero b{font-size:29px}
.pixelHud .pixelMetricName{font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;color:#d4edf0}
.pixelHud .hudWallet{gap:7px;margin-top:7px}
.pixelHud .hudWallet b{font-size:17px;color:var(--pix-gold)}
.pixelHud .hudWallet>div>span:not(.pixelMoneyIcon){color:#c6e6ed;font-size:10px}
.pixelHud .hudProtected{border:2px solid #24566b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #061623;background:#102a3b;color:#d3e6e7;min-height:23px;padding:5px 3px;font-size:10px}
.pixelHud .hudSectionLabel{background:#0b2d44;color:#9ce9f5;border-left:4px solid #36cde0;border-bottom:2px solid #17617a;padding:5px 7px 4px;margin:10px 0 7px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.3}
.pixelHud .hudKinds{gap:6px}
.pixelHud .hudKind{border:3px solid #6c5a3b;border-bottom-width:5px;background:#182330;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #101c2b,3px 3px 0 #03101a;transition:filter .12s,transform .12s;image-rendering:pixelated;min-height:137px;padding:4px 2px 3px}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stand]{border-color:#bf8938;background:#392b19}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=theater]{border-color:#b3666f;background:#35252d}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stripe]{border-color:#ae70a9;background:#342238}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=permanent]{border-color:#687d8a;background:#202b31}
.pixelHud .hudKind.active{outline:3px solid #b2f25a;outline-offset:1px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b3f68c,3px 3px 0 #03101a;background-color:#3a3d26}
.pixelHud .hudKind:not(:disabled):active{transform:translateY(2px)}
.pixelHud .hudKind:disabled{opacity:.46}
.pixelHud .hudImageWrap{height:80px;flex-basis:80px}
.pixelHud .hudEquipmentImage{max-height:78px;image-rendering:pixelated}
.pixelHud .hudItemName{font-size:9px;line-height:1.3;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 #000}
.pixelHud .hudItemName small{font-size:8px;line-height:1.3;color:#f7ddad}
.pixelHud .hudKind em{font-size:10px;color:#ffdc72}
.pixelHud .hudBuy{gap:6px}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button{height:67px;border:3px solid #1a8cb0;border-bottom:5px solid #09546f;background:#0a2a40;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #061a2a,2px 2px 0 #02111b;padding:5px 1px 2px;gap:3px;color:#d5f4f3;font-size:9px;line-height:1.2;white-space:normal;text-shadow:1px 1px #00111d}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#174a61;border-color:#4ae3df}

.pixelHud .hudBuy button:disabled{opacity:.43}
.pixelHud .hudBuy .hudBuyPlus{width:21px;height:21px;background:#dc8740;border:2px solid #ffba68;box-shadow:2px 2px #592b17;font-size:15px;color:#fff}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button b{background:#f4c554;color:#142236;text-shadow:none;padding:4px 1px;font-size:12px;border-top:2px solid #ffe49c;line-height:1.1}

.pixelHud .hudStart{min-height:38px;border:3px solid #2ae4af;border-bottom:6px solid #0c5b42;background:#127450;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #62e8b6,3px 3px 0 #03101b;font-size:13px}
.gameControls{gap:7px}
.gameControls .hudPause{height:38px;border:3px solid #21aaca;border-bottom:6px solid #06516c;background:#071d2f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #266d8b,3px 3px 0 #06121b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.1;color:#ffcd69;padding:5px 9px;text-shadow:1px 2px 0 #3c2716}
.gameControls .hudFullscreen{width:40px;min-width:40px}

.pauseAction{border:3px solid #1d7796;border-bottom:5px solid #0c4863;border-radius:0;background:#0e2f48;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #14445b;font-size:12px}
.pauseAction.primary{border-color:#54cd9a;background:#175e4a}.pauseAction.danger{border-color:#b26570;background:#502535}
.pauseSetting{border-radius:0;border:2px solid #236781;background:#0e3045}
/* Status belongs to the game UI; never draw a semi-transparent full-width web strip over the store. */
.statline{border:2px solid #155b79!important;border-left:4px solid #2ac7de!important;border-radius:0!important;background:#061e30ed!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #0f3b53,3px 3px 0 #010d18!important;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.35!important;letter-spacing:.1px;max-width:calc(100% - 465px);width:max-content;right:auto!important;left:10px!important;top:58px!important;padding:6px 8px!important;gap:4px;pointer-events:none}
.statline span{display:block}
.statline #boardName{font-family:var(--pixfont)!important;color:#d6f5f1}
.statline #statusCompact{font-family:var(--pixfont)!important;font-size:10px;color:#77e6b3}
.debugToggle{font-family:var(--pixfont)!important;border:3px solid #0a799f;border-radius:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #154962,2px 2px #07121e;background:#092438e8}
@media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:landscape){

/* v0.5.6ay: compact responsive HUD with genuine stepped pixel corners */
:root{--aw-cut:7px;--aw-steps:polygon(0 7px,3px 7px,3px 4px,7px 4px,7px 0,calc(100% - 7px) 0,calc(100% - 7px) 4px,calc(100% - 3px) 4px,calc(100% - 3px) 7px,100% 7px,100% calc(100% - 7px),calc(100% - 3px) calc(100% - 7px),calc(100% - 3px) calc(100% - 4px),calc(100% - 7px) calc(100% - 4px),calc(100% - 7px) 100%,7px 100%,7px calc(100% - 4px),3px calc(100% - 4px),3px calc(100% - 7px),0 calc(100% - 7px));}
/* Reserve about three quarters of the field for gameplay on desktop. */
.gameHUD{width:min(29%,350px)!important;min-width:250px;right:9px!important;top:9px!important;max-height:calc(100% - 18px)!important}
.gameHUD .hudPanel.pixelHud{padding:9px 8px!important;max-height:calc(100% - 1px)!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overflow-y:auto!important;border:0!important;outline:none!important;clip-path:var(--aw-steps);background:#071c2ff6!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #0f7998,inset 0 0 0 6px #123750,inset 0 0 0 8px #061320!important}
/* Refined bevels: each HUD box has 3-step pixel-cut corners, not a bare rectangle. */
.pixelHud .hudScores>div,.pixelHud .hudWallet>div,.pixelHud .hudProtected,.pixelHud .hudKind,.pixelHud .hudBuy button,.gameControls .hudPause,.pauseAction{clip-path:var(--aw-steps)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;outline:none!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #1b7898,inset 0 0 0 4px #0b324c,inset 0 0 0 5px #081a2c!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores{gap:5px!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores>div,.pixelHud .hudWallet>div{padding:6px 7px!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores .hudScoreHero{min-height:46px!important;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) auto!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores .hudScoreMinor{min-height:53px!important;grid-template-columns:29px minmax(0,1fr)!important}
.pixelHud .hudPixelArtIcon{width:24px!important;height:24px!important}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero .hudPixelArtIcon{width:31px!important;height:31px!important}
.pixelHud .pixelMetricName{font-size:10px!important}
.pixelHud .hudScores b{font-size:19px!important}
.pixelHud .hudScoreHero b{font-size:27px!important;letter-spacing:0!important}
.pixelHud .hudWallet{gap:5px!important;margin-top:5px!important}
.pixelHud .hudWallet>div{min-height:52px!important;grid-template-columns:29px minmax(0,1fr)!important;padding:5px!important}
.pixelHud .hudWallet .hudPixelArtIcon{width:25px!important;height:25px!important}
.pixelHud .hudWallet>div>span:not(.pixelMoneyIcon){font-size:9px!important}
.pixelHud .hudWallet b{font-size:14px!important}
.pixelHud .hudProtected{padding:4px!important;font-size:8px!important;margin-top:4px!important;background:#0c283b!important}
.pixelHud .hudSectionLabel{margin:7px 0 4px!important;font-size:10px!important}
.pixelHud .hudKinds,.pixelHud .hudBuy{gap:4px!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind{min-height:113px!important;padding:6px 2px 4px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #537080,inset 0 0 0 4px #142536!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stand]{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b58637,inset 0 0 0 4px #322319!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=theater]{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b76670,inset 0 0 0 4px #30202a!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind[data-kind=stripe]{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b576a7,inset 0 0 0 4px #32203a!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind.active{filter:brightness(1.26);outline:none!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #baf26e,inset 0 0 0 5px #244e3c!important}
.pixelHud .hudImageWrap{height:64px!important;flex-basis:64px!important}
.pixelHud .hudEquipmentImage{max-height:62px!important}
.pixelHud .hudItemName{font-size:8px!important;line-height:1.1!important}
.pixelHud .hudItemName small{font-size:7px!important}
.pixelHud .hudKind em{font-size:8px!important}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button{height:55px!important;padding:4px 1px 1px!important;font-size:8px!important;gap:1px!important}
.pixelHud .hudBuy .hudBuyPlus{width:17px!important;height:17px!important;font-size:12px!important}
.pixelHud .hudBuy button b{font-size:9px!important;padding:3px 0!important}
.pixelHud .hudStart{min-height:28px!important;font-size:10px!important;margin-top:5px!important}
/* Reference-like controls: separated, pixel-cut silhouettes at top-left. */
.gameControls{top:10px!important;left:12px!important;gap:7px!important}
.gameControls .hudPause{width:49px!important;min-width:49px!important;height:49px!important;padding:5px!important;background:#08263a!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #17b5d1,inset 0 0 0 6px #0b405d,inset 0 0 0 8px #041827!important}

.gameControls .hudFullscreen{width:36px!important;min-width:36px!important}.gameControls .hudFullscreen svg{width:20px!important;height:20px!important}.pausePixelBars{width:14px!important;height:17px!important}
.gameCard>.statline{top:43px!important;max-width:calc(62% - 10px)!important}
}

/* JS sets a textual pause caption on startup: hide that caption visually and draw the reference icon. */
.gameControls #hudPause{font-size:0!important;line-height:0!important;color:transparent!important}
.gameControls #hudPause::before{content:"";display:block;width:19px;height:22px;margin:auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f8c65b 0 36%,transparent 36% 64%,#f8c65b 64%);filter:drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 #67451f)}

/* v0.5.6ay — on-capture animation and reward panel in the same pixel HUD vocabulary. */
.arrestScene[hidden]{display:none!important}
.arrestScene{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:42;background:rgba(2,9,19,.77);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;pointer-events:auto;user-select:none}
.arrestStage{width:min(510px,calc(100% - 20px));background:#071b2c;border:3px solid #23bad5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #051322,0 0 0 6px #0e4558,inset 0 0 0 3px #123e54,8px 10px 0 #0009;padding:14px 15px 12px;color:#e9f6ff;font-family:'PixelFont', 'Press Start 2P',monospace;text-align:center;clip-path:polygon(8px 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,calc(100% - 8px) 4px,100% 4px,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,8px 100%,8px calc(100% - 8px),0 calc(100% - 8px),0 8px,8px 8px)}
.arrestEyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#8dcfdb;margin:2px 0 8px}.arrestHeading{font-size:clamp(15px,2.4vw,23px);color:#ffcf65;text-shadow:3px 3px #6b4425;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:3px}
.arrestFilm{height:min(300px,48dvh);display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}.arrestFilm img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;pointer-events:none}
.arrestFooter{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:10px;color:#b0d9e5;margin-top:4px}.arrestProgress{height:9px;background:#00101e;border:2px solid #247d9e;margin-top:8px}.arrestProgress span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:#efc45a}
/* Reward shown only after ten arrest frames; preserve the HUD's navy/cyan/gold pixel style. */
.thiefAlert{background:#030d1cb8;align-items:center;z-index:41}
.thiefAlertPanel{background:#071b2cf8!important;border:3px solid #20b4d4!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #061522,0 0 0 6px #134960,inset 0 0 0 3px #143d53,8px 10px 0 #000a!important;font-family:'PixelFont','Press Start 2P',monospace!important;max-width:515px}
.thiefAlertEyebrow{font-family:inherit!important;color:#8bc9dd!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.4px}
.thiefAlertPanel h2{font-family:inherit!important;color:#f6ca65!important;text-shadow:2px 2px #694422;font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,22px)!important}
.thiefAlertPanel p{color:#e3eff5;line-height:1.7;font-size:clamp(11px,1.25vw,14px)!important}
.thiefAlertPanel #thiefAlertOK{border:2px solid #48c9c3;border-bottom:4px solid #0a5f63;border-radius:0;background:#116869;color:#f4fffc;font-family:inherit!important;font-size:13px;box-shadow:inset 2px 2px #2a9b9b}
@media(max-height:500px){.arrestStage{padding:7px}.arrestEyebrow{margin:0 0 3px}.arrestFilm{height:min(240px,42dvh)}.arrestFooter{margin-top:0}.arrestProgress{margin-top:3px}.thiefAlertPanel{max-height:88dvh;overflow-y:auto}}

/* v0.5.6az: score-funded permanent merch dismissal; all art from original game. */
.fireScene[hidden]{display:none!important}
.fireScene{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:43;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#020c1bc9;pointer-events:auto;padding:10px}
.fireStage{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(510px,96%);padding:12px;background:#071b2c;color:#e6f6ff;text-align:center;font-family:'PixelFont',monospace;border:3px solid #1eb5d0;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #051322,0 0 0 7px #10415a,inset 0 0 0 3px #16445c,7px 9px 0 #0008;clip-path:polygon(8px 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,calc(100% - 8px) 5px,100% 5px,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,8px 100%,8px calc(100% - 5px),0 calc(100% - 5px),0 5px,8px 5px)}
.fireEyebrow{font-size:10px;color:#8bcdda;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}.fireHeading{font-size:clamp(17px,3vw,25px);color:#ffce60;text-shadow:2px 3px #674224}
.fireFilm{position:relative;height:205px;margin-top:9px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(#122e46 0%,#172f3c 67%,#304351 67%,#273543 100%);border:3px solid #1d6483;image-rendering:pixelated}
.fireFloor{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:4px;height:2px;background:#72939d}

/* v0.5.6bl — lunch race ending, scoped pixel UI */
.lunchRaceHud{margin:6px 0 0;padding:6px 8px;border:2px solid #1594b6;background:#071b2e;color:#e3f6ff;font:10px 'PixelFont',ui-monospace,monospace;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #102f45;text-align:center;line-height:1.55}
.lunchRaceHud[hidden]{display:none!important}.lunchRaceHud strong{color:#ffd16c;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}.lunchRaceHud .lunchRaceProgress{height:7px;background:#0c2435;margin-top:5px;border:1px solid #145879}.lunchRaceProgress i{display:block;height:100%;width:0%;background:#f7c651;transition:width .2s}
.lunchComic[hidden]{display:none!important}.lunchComic{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:85;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:12px;background:#020917e8;pointer-events:auto;overflow-y:auto}
.lunchComicCard{width:min(620px,100%);max-height:96%;overflow:auto;padding:15px 18px 13px;background:#091e32;border:4px solid #0e91b5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #020d1b,0 0 0 5px #70d6de,inset 0 0 0 3px #183a55,8px 10px 0 #0009;color:#e9faff;text-align:center;font-family:'PixelFont',ui-monospace,monospace}
.lunchComicTop{letter-spacing:2px;font-size:9px;color:#7ff6de}.lunchComicTitle{font-size:clamp(17px,3vw,28px);line-height:1.4;color:#ffce62;text-shadow:2px 3px #502b21;margin:6px 0}
.lunchComicClock{display:inline-block;margin:3px 0 8px;padding:6px 11px;background:#102f46;border:2px solid #51b9d4;color:#ffe088;font-size:17px}
.lunchComicPanel{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:space-evenly;align-items:flex-end;min-height:175px;background:linear-gradient(#14344a 0%,#1a3448 76%,#374858 76%,#25374b 100%);border:3px solid #2c6a8e;overflow:hidden;padding:9px 10px 0}
.lunchComicHero{image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;width:clamp(82px,20%,125px);height:155px;filter:drop-shadow(3px 3px 1px #07121f);animation:lunchHeroBounce 1s steps(2,end) infinite}
.lunchComicScene{flex:1;display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:center;justify-items:center;min-width:0;padding:10px}
.lunchComicBubble{border:2px solid #0a1a29;background:#f9eed6;color:#182638;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #0a1827;padding:12px;font-size:clamp(11px,1.8vw,16px);line-height:1.6;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.lunchComicStamp{font-size:clamp(13px,2.7vw,24px);color:#7befd0;text-shadow:2px 3px #0a1528}
.lunchComicFooter{font-size:10px;color:#8ed4e5;margin:9px 0}.lunchComicButton{background:#126a58;border:3px solid #75e8b3;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px #075046,3px 3px #0009;color:#fff7ce;font:bold 12px 'PixelFont',monospace;min-height:42px;width:min(330px,100%);cursor:pointer;padding:7px 10px}
.lunchComicButton:active{transform:translate(2px,2px)}.lunchComicTitle.good{color:#85efb1}.lunchComicTitle.bad{color:#ff8995}
@keyframes lunchHeroBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@media(max-height:500px){.lunchComicCard{padding:7px 12px}.lunchComicPanel{min-height:125px}.lunchComicHero{height:115px}.lunchComicTitle{margin:2px 0}.lunchComicBubble{padding:8px}.lunchComicFooter{margin:4px 0}.lunchComicClock{margin:1px 0 3px;padding:3px 6px}}

/* v0.5.6bp — approved Max Payne-inspired full-page comic sequences */
#storyCinematic[hidden]{display:none!important}
#storyCinematic{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:130;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:clamp(4px,1vw,10px);background:#030710f5;color:#f6efdc;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none;overflow:hidden;font-family:'PixelFont',ui-monospace,monospace}
.storyHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:21px;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:clamp(8px,1vw,12px);color:#ffdb88;letter-spacing:.03em}
.storyHeader .storyBrand{color:#9adbe2;white-space:nowrap}
.storySceneName{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:42%;text-align:center}
.storySkip{color:#fff2d1;background:#1c2c3c;border:2px solid #588aa0;padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;white-space:nowrap;touch-action:manipulation}
.storySkip:hover,.storyNext:hover{background:#31465b}
.storyPageWrap{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;min-height:0;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.storyPage{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/2;background:#020205;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #334e61,0 0 0 3px #070e19,0 10px 30px #0009;touch-action:manipulation}
.storyGhost{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill;opacity:.14;filter:brightness(.30) grayscale(.62);pointer-events:none}
.storyFrame{position:absolute;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;background:#040609;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #0009;clip-path:none!important;transform:none!important;transition:none!important}
.storyFrame.on{opacity:1;transform:none!important;animation:none!important;clip-path:none!important;filter:none!important}
.storyFrame img{position:absolute;max-width:none;display:block;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;image-rendering:auto;transform:none!important;animation:none!important;filter:none!important}
.storyFooter{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;min-height:24px;flex:0 0 auto;color:#a4bbcb;font-size:clamp(8px,.85vw,11px)}
.storyProgress{flex:1;max-width:190px;display:flex;gap:4px}
.storyTick{height:6px;flex:1;background:#27445a;border:1px solid #42637a}
.storyTick.on{background:#efbe64;box-shadow:0 0 5px #f6c16d66}
.storyNext{background:#162c3e;border:2px solid #ad8448;color:#ffda94;padding:5px 9px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font:inherit;font-size:inherit;touch-action:manipulation}
.storyFooterText{max-width:45%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.storyPage:focus-visible,.storyNext:focus-visible,.storySkip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffd16f;outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:740px){#storyCinematic{padding:3px;gap:2px}.storyHeader{min-height:17px;font-size:8px}.storyHeader .storyBrand{font-size:8px}.storySkip{padding:2px 5px}.storyFooter{min-height:21px;font-size:8px;gap:4px}.storyNext{padding:3px 5px}.storyFooterText{max-width:35%}}

 touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
